problem_statement:
Bug #30628160: DYNAMIC PRIVILEGES CAN BE GRANTED AT PROCEDURE/FUNCTION LEVEL
RB#24036

The list of dynamic privileges wasn't checked when processing procedure
of function grants.
This resulted in them silently being ignored for GRANT ... ON PROCEDURE
... statements.

Fixed by moving the check for non-empty dynamic privileges so it covers
the procedures/functions too.

Test case added.
